title: Middle of the Linked List
statement: Given list values, return the value at the middle node. If there are two middles, return the second middle. Use slow/fast pointers conceptually.
brute_force_code:
def find_middle(values):
    # Count length then walk n//2 steps
    n = len(values)
    return values[n // 2]

predict_steps.prompt: When fast reaches the end, where is slow?

learn_quiz.question: Slow moves one step while fast moves?
For even length, this method returns?
Why avoid counting length first?
choices: One pass is enough with two pointers
